businessVision: ProjectOS is a Universal Project Delivery OS: a local, owner-controlled system that plans, governs, executes and proves software delivery end-to-end across many projects, with no external metered AI orchestration API. V3 extends the closed V2 foundation into an owner-controlled autonomous delivery system in which the owner approves a plan and ProjectOS drives controlled, gated execution against it.
definitionOfComplete: For an owner-approved project: vision, plan, execution plan and definition-of-complete are recorded and approved; ProjectOS drives a phased roadmap under deterministic governance; every phase is validated, reviewed and evidenced before closure; production/database/external-send/payment actions are owner-gated; no external AI-agent API is required; and the owner can start, pause, gate and close autonomous execution from a single control surface.
approvedScope: Plan-governance foundation: plan persistence, plan-memory model, current-state model, active-session model
PLAN READY evidence gate and deterministic plan-status model
Immutable plan versioning and deterministic staleness detection
excludedScope: Owner chat UI, project selector UI, Start-E2E UI
VS Code launcher, Claude automation, ChatGPT automation
E2E phase runner and provider operations
PolyGo installation and any production or staging functionality
Any OpenAI, Anthropic, or metered AI-agent API integration
successStandard: The owner can approve a plan once and then supervise controlled, evidenced, gated delivery of a real project to its definition-of-complete — with no external AI API, no ungated irreversible action, and a complete audit trail — while retaining single-click authority to start, pause, gate and close.

phases.description: Read-only V3 baseline and plan-start reconciliation.
Persist master plan, create plan-memory/current-state/active-session models, implement the PLAN READY gate, plan versioning and staleness.
acceptanceCriteria: Owner approval required; implementer cannot approve
Material staleness detected; ordinary progress does not stale
No raw secret present; no external AI API used

security.secretPolicy: No raw secret values are stored in plan memory, current state, sessions, reports or prompts. Providers are referenced by name only. Redaction is required for any sensitive value.
